title: openinference, openai-agents: top-level span status is OK

tries.explanation: The on_trace_end method unconditionally sets the root span status to OK, even when the run raised an exception. The fix tracks error status per trace_id in a new _trace_errors dict: whenever on_span_end processes a span with span.error it stores the ERROR status keyed by trace_id, and on_trace_end uses that stored status instead of OK when present. Successful runs and tool-raises-but-recovers scenarios are unaffected because no span.error means nothing is stored.

"""Tests that the root (trace-level) span status is ERROR when the agent run raises."""
from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any

import pytest
from agents import Agent, Runner
from agents.exceptions import MaxTurnsExceeded
from agents.items import ModelResponse
from agents.models.interface import Model
from agents.usage import Usage
from openai import InternalServerError
from openai.types.responses import ResponseOutputMessage, ResponseOutputText
from opentelemetry.sdk import trace as trace_sdk
from opentelemetry.sdk.trace import ReadableSpan
from opentelemetry.sdk.trace.export import SimpleSpanProcessor
from opentelemetry.sdk.trace.export.in_memory_span_exporter import InMemorySpanExporter
from opentelemetry.trace import StatusCode

import httpx

from openinference.instrumentation.openai_agents import OpenAIAgentsInstrumentor


class _OkModel(Model):
    async def get_response(self, *args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> ModelResponse:
        return ModelResponse(
            output=[
                ResponseOutputMessage(
                    id="m1",
                    type="message",
                    role="assistant",
                    status="completed",
                    content=[ResponseOutputText(type="output_text", text="done", annotations=[])],
                )
            ],
            usage=Usage(),
            response_id=None,
        )

    def stream_response(self, *args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> Any:
        raise NotImplementedError


class _ErrorModel(Model):
    async def get_response(self, *args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> ModelResponse:
        raise InternalServerError(
            message="fake server error",
            response=httpx.Response(
                500, request=httpx.Request("POST", "https://api.openai.com")
            ),
            body={"error": {"message": "fake server error"}},
        )

    def stream_response(self, *args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> Any:
        raise NotImplementedError


class _LoopModel(Model):
    async def get_response(self, *args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> ModelResponse:
        return ModelResponse(output=[], usage=Usage(), response_id=None)

    def stream_response(self, *args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> Any:
        raise NotImplementedError


@pytest.fixture
def exporter() -> Any:
    exp = InMemorySpanExporter()
    provider = trace_sdk.TracerProvider()
    provider.add_span_processor(SimpleSpanProcessor(exp))
    OpenAIAgentsInstrumentor().instrument(tracer_provider=provider)
    yield exp
    OpenAIAgentsInstrumentor().uninstrument()


def _root_span(spans: list[ReadableSpan]) -> ReadableSpan:
    roots = [s for s in spans if s.parent is None]
    assert len(roots) == 1, f"expected 1 root span, got {len(roots)}: {[s.name for s in roots]}"
    return roots[0]


async def test_root_span_ok_when_run_succeeds(exporter: InMemorySpanExporter) -> None:
    agent = Agent(name="helper", model=_OkModel())
    await Runner.run(agent, "hi")
    root = _root_span(list(exporter.get_finished_spans()))
    assert root.status.status_code == StatusCode.OK


async def test_root_span_error_when_llm_fails(exporter: InMemorySpanExporter) -> None:
    agent = Agent(name="helper", model=_ErrorModel())
    with pytest.raises(InternalServerError):
        await Runner.run(agent, "hi")
    root = _root_span(list(exporter.get_finished_spans()))
    assert root.status.status_code == StatusCode.ERROR, (
        f"expected ERROR got {root.status.status_code}; desc={root.status.description!r}"
    )


async def test_root_span_error_when_max_turns_exceeded(exporter: InMemorySpanExporter) -> None:
    agent = Agent(name="helper", model=_LoopModel())
    with pytest.raises(MaxTurnsExceeded):
        await Runner.run(agent, "hi", max_turns=1)
    root = _root_span(list(exporter.get_finished_spans()))
    assert root.status.status_code == StatusCode.ERROR, (
        f"expected ERROR got {root.status.status_code}; desc={root.status.description!r}"
    )

test.content:
"""Tests that the root (trace-level) span status is ERROR when a child span has an error."""
from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any, Iterator

import pytest
from agents.tracing.span_data import AgentSpanData
from opentelemetry.sdk import trace as trace_sdk
from opentelemetry.sdk.trace import ReadableSpan
from opentelemetry.sdk.trace.export import SimpleSpanProcessor
from opentelemetry.sdk.trace.export.in_memory_span_exporter import InMemorySpanExporter
from opentelemetry.trace import StatusCode

from openinference.instrumentation.openai_agents._processor import OpenInferenceTracingProcessor


def _make_processor() -> tuple[OpenInferenceTracingProcessor, InMemorySpanExporter]:
    exp = InMemorySpanExporter()
    provider = trace_sdk.TracerProvider()
    provider.add_span_processor(SimpleSpanProcessor(exp))
    tracer = provider.get_tracer("test")
    processor = OpenInferenceTracingProcessor(tracer)  # type: ignore[arg-type]
    return processor, exp


class _FakeSpanData(AgentSpanData):
    def __init__(self, name: str = "helper") -> None:
        super().__init__(name=name)


class _FakeSpan:
    def __init__(
        self,
        span_id: str,
        trace_id: str,
        parent_id: str | None,
        error: dict[str, Any] | None,
        name: str = "helper",
    ) -> None:
        self.span_id = span_id
        self.trace_id = trace_id
        self.parent_id = parent_id
        self.span_data = _FakeSpanData(name=name)
        self.started_at = "2024-01-01T00:00:00+00:00"
        self.ended_at = "2024-01-01T00:00:01+00:00"
        self.error = error


class _FakeTrace:
    def __init__(self, trace_id: str, name: str = "Agent workflow") -> None:
        self.trace_id = trace_id
        self.name = name


def _root_span(spans: list[ReadableSpan]) -> ReadableSpan:
    roots = [s for s in spans if s.parent is None]
    assert len(roots) == 1, f"expected 1 root span, got {len(roots)}: {[s.name for s in spans]}"
    return roots[0]


def test_root_span_ok_when_no_child_error() -> None:
    processor, exp = _make_processor()
    trace_id = "trace-ok-1"
    fake_trace = _FakeTrace(trace_id)
    processor.on_trace_start(fake_trace)

    span = _FakeSpan("span-1", trace_id, None, error=None)
    processor.on_span_start(span)
    processor.on_span_end(span)

    processor.on_trace_end(fake_trace)

    root = _root_span(list(exp.get_finished_spans()))
    assert root.status.status_code == StatusCode.OK


def test_root_span_error_when_child_has_error() -> None:
    """When a child span carries span.error the root span must be ERROR."""
    processor, exp = _make_processor()
    trace_id = "trace-err-1"
    fake_trace = _FakeTrace(trace_id)
    processor.on_trace_start(fake_trace)

    span = _FakeSpan(
        "span-2",
        trace_id,
        None,
        error={"message": "Error in agent run", "data": "InternalServerError"},
    )
    processor.on_span_start(span)
    processor.on_span_end(span)

    processor.on_trace_end(fake_trace)

    root = _root_span(list(exp.get_finished_spans()))
    assert root.status.status_code == StatusCode.ERROR, (
        f"expected ERROR, got {root.status.status_code}; description={root.status.description!r}"
    )


def test_root_span_error_description_propagated() -> None:
    processor, exp = _make_processor()
    trace_id = "trace-err-2"
    fake_trace = _FakeTrace(trace_id)
    processor.on_trace_start(fake_trace)

    span = _FakeSpan(
        "span-3",
        trace_id,
        None,
        error={"message": "Max turns exceeded", "data": {"max_turns": 3}},
    )
    processor.on_span_start(span)
    processor.on_span_end(span)

    processor.on_trace_end(fake_trace)

    root = _root_span(list(exp.get_finished_spans()))
    assert root.status.status_code == StatusCode.ERROR
    assert root.status.description is not None
    assert "Max turns exceeded" in root.status.description

"""Tests that the root (trace-level) span status is ERROR when an agent span has an error,
but stays OK when only a tool span has a non-fatal error."""
from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any

from agents.tracing.span_data import AgentSpanData, FunctionSpanData
from opentelemetry.sdk import trace as trace_sdk
from opentelemetry.sdk.trace import ReadableSpan
from opentelemetry.sdk.trace.export import SimpleSpanProcessor
from opentelemetry.sdk.trace.export.in_memory_span_exporter import InMemorySpanExporter
from opentelemetry.trace import StatusCode

from openinference.instrumentation.openai_agents._processor import OpenInferenceTracingProcessor


def _make_processor() -> tuple[OpenInferenceTracingProcessor, InMemorySpanExporter]:
    exp = InMemorySpanExporter()
    provider = trace_sdk.TracerProvider()
    provider.add_span_processor(SimpleSpanProcessor(exp))
    tracer = provider.get_tracer("test")
    processor = OpenInferenceTracingProcessor(tracer)  # type: ignore[arg-type]
    return processor, exp


class _FakeAgentSpan:
    """Minimal fake of agents.tracing.Span with AgentSpanData."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        span_id: str,
        trace_id: str,
        parent_id: str | None,
        error: dict[str, Any] | None,
        name: str = "helper",
    ) -> None:
        self.span_id = span_id
        self.trace_id = trace_id
        self.parent_id = parent_id
        self.span_data = AgentSpanData(name=name)
        self.started_at = "2024-01-01T00:00:00+00:00"
        self.ended_at = "2024-01-01T00:00:01+00:00"
        self.error = error


class _FakeFunctionSpan:
    """Minimal fake of agents.tracing.Span with FunctionSpanData (tool span)."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        span_id: str,
        trace_id: str,
        parent_id: str | None,
        error: dict[str, Any] | None,
        name: str = "get_weather",
    ) -> None:
        self.span_id = span_id
        self.trace_id = trace_id
        self.parent_id = parent_id
        self.span_data = FunctionSpanData(name=name, input=None, output=None)
        self.started_at = "2024-01-01T00:00:00+00:00"
        self.ended_at = "2024-01-01T00:00:01+00:00"
        self.error = error


class _FakeTrace:
    def __init__(self, trace_id: str, name: str = "Agent workflow") -> None:
        self.trace_id = trace_id
        self.name = name


def _root_span(spans: list[ReadableSpan]) -> ReadableSpan:
    roots = [s for s in spans if s.parent is None]
    assert len(roots) == 1, f"expected 1 root span, got {len(roots)}: {[s.name for s in spans]}"
    return roots[0]


def test_root_span_ok_when_no_error() -> None:
    """Successful run: root span must be OK."""
    processor, exp = _make_processor()
    trace_id = "trace-ok-1"
    fake_trace = _FakeTrace(trace_id)
    processor.on_trace_start(fake_trace)

    span = _FakeAgentSpan("span-1", trace_id, None, error=None)
    processor.on_span_start(span)
    processor.on_span_end(span)

    processor.on_trace_end(fake_trace)

    root = _root_span(list(exp.get_finished_spans()))
    assert root.status.status_code == StatusCode.OK


def test_root_span_error_when_agent_span_has_error() -> None:
    """When the agent span carries span.error the root span must be ERROR."""
    processor, exp = _make_processor()
    trace_id = "trace-err-1"
    fake_trace = _FakeTrace(trace_id)
    processor.on_trace_start(fake_trace)

    span = _FakeAgentSpan(
        "span-2",
        trace_id,
        None,
        error={"message": "Error in agent run", "data": "InternalServerError"},
    )
    processor.on_span_start(span)
    processor.on_span_end(span)

    processor.on_trace_end(fake_trace)

    root = _root_span(list(exp.get_finished_spans()))
    assert root.status.status_code == StatusCode.ERROR, (
        f"expected ERROR, got {root.status.status_code}; description={root.status.description!r}"
    )


def test_root_span_ok_when_only_tool_span_has_nonfatal_error() -> None:
    """ag-tool-raises: tool raised but run finished OK; root span must stay OK."""
    processor, exp = _make_processor()
    trace_id = "trace-tool-raises-1"
    fake_trace = _FakeTrace(trace_id)
    processor.on_trace_start(fake_trace)

    tool_span = _FakeFunctionSpan(
        "span-tool-1",
        trace_id,
        None,
        error={"message": "Error running tool (non-fatal)", "data": {"tool_name": "get_weather", "error": "Tool exec failed"}},
    )
    processor.on_span_start(tool_span)
    processor.on_span_end(tool_span)

    agent_span = _FakeAgentSpan("span-agent-1", trace_id, None, error=None)
    processor.on_span_start(agent_span)
    processor.on_span_end(agent_span)

    processor.on_trace_end(fake_trace)

    root = _root_span(list(exp.get_finished_spans()))
    assert root.status.status_code == StatusCode.OK, (
        f"expected OK, got {root.status.status_code}; description={root.status.description!r}"
    )


def test_root_span_error_description_propagated() -> None:
    """The error description from the agent span must appear on the root span."""
    processor, exp = _make_processor()
    trace_id = "trace-err-2"
    fake_trace = _FakeTrace(trace_id)
    processor.on_trace_start(fake_trace)

    span = _FakeAgentSpan(
        "span-3",
        trace_id,
        None,
        error={"message": "Max turns exceeded", "data": {"max_turns": 3}},
    )
    processor.on_span_start(span)
    processor.on_span_end(span)

    processor.on_trace_end(fake_trace)

    root = _root_span(list(exp.get_finished_spans()))
    assert root.status.status_code == StatusCode.ERROR
    assert root.status.description is not None
    assert "Max turns exceeded" in root.status.description
